objectivesNote: Each objective adds its own weight to your multiplier (1–6). Claim them on your submission too — HaLo totals them, it does not report them.

objectiveWinlink: Winlink — send and receive over RF (×1)
objectiveSixBands: Three contacts on six or more bands (×6)
objectiveTwelveBands: Three contacts on twelve or more bands (×6)
